messages:
Alana (PM): Quick sync — field alpha requests coming in for private deploy (VPC/on-prem). Need to agree MVP scope, launch gates, and measurable constraints by EOD.
Sam (Eng Runtime): TL;DR we can deliver operator + slim installer for alpha, but IP preservation and live upgrade will be heavy.
Kevin (Field SE): Customer asks: preserve public IPs, predictable egress, and limited downtime during upgrade. Several can't reassign IPs.
Maria (SRE): For onboarding we need: deterministic egress IPs, DNS validation, and health-check endpoints. Also metric: installation success >= 95% in lab.
Olivia (Design): UX ask: admin console for network mapping + a one-click rollback UI for upgrades. Can be basic for alpha.
Nate (Solutions): Also need clear preflight checks: kube version, node count, free disk, IP pools. Field loves checklists.
Sam (Eng Runtime): Agree. Proposed alpha MVP: operator install, preflight checks, IP-preserve option (best-effort), docs for customer-managed NAT, manual upgrade flow.
Alana (PM): OK define launch gates: 1) Installer + operator tested in 3 customer labs, 2) Upgrade dry-run success in staging, 3) Preflight pass rate >= 90% across labs.
Kevin (Field SE): Can we add a constraint: upgrade rollback time <= 10 minutes for control-plane services? Customers requested hard windows.
Maria (SRE): We'll measure rollback RTO in staging; aim for <=10m for control-plane 95th perc. Also define observability: token-level cost/latency traces must be available.
Sam (Eng Runtime): Technical caveat: IP preservation full guarantee requires NAT-relay or SNAT translation; implementing NAT-relay for alpha is medium effort. If we skip, we must document manual egress mapping.
Alana (PM): Decision needed: include NAT-relay (adds 2 sprint cost) OR ship without but provide clear migration playbook. Thoughts?
Kevin (Field SE): Field vote: include NAT-relay. Most customers will push back otherwise.
Olivia (Design): If NAT-relay included, we need an onboarding flow that surfaces network impact and simulated egress test.
Nate (Solutions): Add an accept criteria: `./rcli preflight --network-check` passes and `curl https://example.com/egress-check` returns customer IP.
Sam (Eng Runtime): Tentative plan: include NAT-relay as opt-in in alpha; operator will default to disabled. Implement basic HA for relay later.
Alana (PM): Great — will update roadmap. Action items: Sam to scope nat-relay sprint, Maria to define preflight metrics, Kevin to collect 3 customer labs, Olivia to draft onboarding flows. I'll collate and send to execs.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: private-alpha branch to staging at 2026-03-22T15:30:00Z :rocket:
Kevin (Field SE): ack, I'll start outreach to the lab customers this afternoon :+1:
Alana (PM): Thanks all — if no objections by EOD we'll mark MVP and start tickets.
